items.title: Indian bonds track US Treasuries higher amid oil-price relief
items.content: Indian government bonds increased on Thursday due to support from a rally in Treasuries and lower oil prices. However, the upcoming large bond sale and a weak rupee limited the extent of the gains observed. The benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield fell slightly below the significant 7.40% level during early trading hours. Meanwhile, the Reserve Bank of India previously raised the repo rate amid ongoing inflation concerns.

The surprising response resembles the immune boost seen during exercise and may help explain some of the health benefits linked to sauna bathing.

items.title: A simple daily fiber supplement reduced arthritis pain and improved strength
items.content: A new clinical trial suggests that a simple daily fiber supplement could significantly reduce knee osteoarthritis pain, improve muscle strength, and make the body less sensitive to pain. Researchers discovered that the benefits may be linked to changes in gut bacteria and the hormone GLP-1, revealing a promising new approach to arthritis relief.
